description: Set or update the reorder policy for items at a warehouse: reorder point (the low-stock threshold), and optionally restock quantity, safety-stock days, and lead-time days. A reorder point or restock quantity you set is pinned (it won't auto-recalculate from velocity), so setting a reorder point ABOVE current available intentionally stages a low-stock situation. A line with only lead-time or safety-stock days keeps a calculated policy calculated, recomputed with the new inputs (preview shows its new reorder point and quantity as null). Each line is matched by SKU then UPC; unmatched identifiers are reported, not fatal. A line may name its own warehouseId, so one call can edit policies at several warehouses (read them first with get_replenishment_settings). A line's pinned=true freezes its reorder point and quantity; pinned=false returns them to the calculation. Omit warehouseId when the tenant has exactly one Internal warehouse or every line names one. Max 500 lines per call.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants: confines SKU/UPC matching to that client's items — get ids from list_clients. Client-pinned credentials omit this; the credential decides.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

policies.description: Reorder policies to set/update (max 500 per call).

leadTimeDays.description: Optional lead-time override in days (0-365). Omit to keep the existing value.

pinned.description: Optional. true pins the policy: its reorder point and quantity stop recalculating from velocity (a warehouse with no policy yet also needs reorderPoint). false unpins it: both are recalculated from velocity, lead time and safety stock, so it cannot be combined with reorderPoint or reorderQuantity. Omit to pin only when the line sets reorderPoint or reorderQuantity.

reorderPoint.description: Reorder point: the item flags as low stock when available drops below this. Set it above current on-hand to intentionally stage a low-stock situation. Must be >= 0. Preserve-on-null like the other fields: omit to keep the existing value (a new policy row defaults to 0), so a partial update never silently zeroes it.

reorderQuantity.description: Optional restock quantity to reorder when the point is hit. Omit to keep the existing value (new policy rows default to 0).

safetyStockDays.description: Optional days of buffer stock (0-365). Omit to keep the existing value.

upc.description: Item UPC/barcode, used when SKU is absent or unmatched.

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id (GUID) for this line, so one call can set policies at several warehouses. Omit to use the call's warehouseId.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured old→new preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is changed until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id (GUID). May be omitted when the tenant has exactly one Internal warehouse; an explicit id may target any of the tenant's warehouses.

title: Set Inventory Policy
